article.headline: Jaden Winston scores 20 to propel Pacific to 63-52 victory over Bradley
article.description: — Jaden Winston scored 20 points as Pacific beat Bradley 63-52 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Jaden Winston scores 20 to propel Pacific to 63-52 victory over Bradley
article.story: PEORIA, Ill. -- — Jaden Winston scored 20 points as Pacific beat Bradley 63-52 on Saturday. Winston also contributed five steals for the Tigers (2-0). Adriel Nyorha totaled 17 points and seven rebounds. Jaion Pitt added 14 points and seven boards. Trevon Payton led the Braves (1-1) with 16 points. Noah Williams added 12 points and Josh Ibukunoluwa finished with nine points and eight rebounds. Pacific took the lead for good with 15:42 to go in the first half. The score was 29-19 at halftime, with Pitt scoring 12. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
